bug_semantics: In the Xorg DRI2 request path, a client controls the attachment list passed by ProcDRI2GetBuffers or ProcDRI2GetBuffersWithFormat to do_get_buffers. The vulnerable code allocates count + 1 DRI2BufferPtr slots but treats requested attachment multiplicity as arithmetic: every DRI2BufferBackLeft increments need_real_front, while one DRI2BufferFrontLeft decrements it only once and also increments need_fake_front for a window. With at least two BackLeft entries and one FrontLeft, both counters remain positive after the count input entries are stored, so the function appends both an implicit real-front and an implicit fake-front buffer. The fake-front pointer is written at buffers[count + 1], one element beyond the count + 1 allocation, causing a client-triggerable heap out-of-bounds write and permitting server crash or privilege escalation when the X server is privileged.
flaw_origin: ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341 replaced the earlier bulk CreateBuffers path with the new per-attachment do_get_buffers implementation for DRI2GetBuffersWithFormat. In that same atomic change it introduced the undersized buffers = xalloc((count + 1) * sizeof(buffers[0])) allocation, the multiplicity-sensitive need_real_front/need_fake_front counters, and the two independent post-loop buffers[i++] appends. That newly created combination is the root cause; 4fad615d689c61c6c3a000295a1fa755359737cb is a later branch cherry-pick of the same patch, not the original BIC.

evidence: First-party advisory: https://lists.x.org/archives/xorg-announce/2026-June/003702.html describes the DRI2 DRIGetBuffers/DRIGetBuffersWithFormat OOB write, the multiple-BackLeft plus one-FrontLeft trigger, fixed releases xorg-server-21.1.23 and xwayland-24.1.12, and both b7aa65cc3bb11b792ce2a3f511ba9b863acb11c8 and 339c279514326134b0878fc23ce6e9520440ce7f. In the validated clone, `git show --format=fuller --patch ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341 -- hw/xfree86/dri2/dri2.c hw/xfree86/dri2/dri2ext.c` shows the BIC adding the count+1 pointer allocation, client attachment loop, integer counters, and both post-loop appends. `git log -L 160,280:hw/xfree86/dri2/dri2.c ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341` attributes that complete vulnerable construction to ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341. `git log --all --format='%H %s' -S'int need_real_front = 0' -- hw/xfree86/dri2/dri2.c` finds ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341 as the original and 4fad615d689c61c6c3a000295a1fa755359737cb as the later branch copy; `git show -s --format='%H%n%P%n%aI%n%cI%n%B' 4fad615d689c61c6c3a000295a1fa755359737cb` shows its later 2009-06-11 committer date. Parent verification: `git diff 28ddfc88d8d547941c7f4713db527a3c2f9ec35a ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341 -- hw/xfree86/dri2/dri2.c` shows the vulnerable implementation is newly added, and `git grep -n -e 'need_real_front' -e 'buffers = xalloc' 28ddfc88d8d547941c7f4713db527a3c2f9ec35a -- hw/xfree86/dri2/dri2.c` has no such vulnerable counter or buffers allocation (the parent instead builds a temporary attachment list and calls CreateBuffers). Version checks: `git merge-base --is-ancestor ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341 xorg-server-1.7.0^{}` succeeds, the same check against xorg-server-1.6.3^{} fails, and `git tag --contains ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341 --list 'xorg-server-1.[67]*' --sort=version:refname` starts at development tag xorg-server-1.6.99.900 and stable xorg-server-1.7.0. Fix lifecycle: `git show --patch b7aa65cc3bb11b792ce2a3f511ba9b863acb11c8` explicitly says Fixes: ff6c7764c290 and changes the counters to booleans plus have_real_front/have_fake_front tests, ensuring no more than one implicit append; its immediate successor 339c279514326134b0878fc23ce6e9520440ce7f deduplicates attachments, bounds attachment values/count, and is the advisory-linked hardening commit (`git rev-parse 339c279514326134b0878fc23ce6e9520440ce7f^` returns b7aa65cc3bb11b792ce2a3f511ba9b863acb11c8). Stable cherry-picks are 4926348d826b7dc12d51d7e41bd9068aee5f90af and f0b8e6e1d969548c0625051d56a780e5df39de26; `git tag --contains 4926348d826b7dc12d51d7e41bd9068aee5f90af --list 'xorg-server-21.1.*'` returns 21.1.23 and 21.1.24, while ancestry against 21.1.22 fails. The exact vulnerable hw/xfree86/dri2/dri2.c path is absent from xwayland-24.1.11's tree, so the source-level affected surface established here is the Xorg DDX even though the umbrella security announcement names both product release trains. Finally, `git cat-file -p ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341` reproduces the BIC-only marker check.
reasoning: The request handlers introduced by ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341 pass a client-selected count and attachment sequence into a newly introduced per-buffer allocation loop. For the minimal triggering shape of two BackLeft attachments and one FrontLeft on a window, the BIC's arithmetic ends with need_real_front == 1 and need_fake_front == 1. After three requested buffers occupy indices 0 through 2 of a four-slot allocation, the implicit real front occupies index 3 and the implicit fake front writes index 4 out of bounds. The immediate parent does not contain this per-attachment array/counter mechanism, and line history plus pickaxe locate its first original write in ff6c7764c2909e4126403b7211faa6c58556b341 rather than the later branch copy. The direct fix b7aa65cc3bb11b792ce2a3f511ba9b863acb11c8 converts multiplicity arithmetic to presence booleans, so the already-requested real front prevents a second real-front append; 339c279514326134b0878fc23ce6e9520440ce7f then closes duplicate and invalid-attachment behavior comprehensively. Stable backports land in xorg-server-21.1.23. Because the 2009 BIC commit object has only named human author/committer and conventional human review/sign-off trailers, with no AI or bot marker, the BIC-only verdict is NOT_AI.
